# Triton job adapters

`build.sh` prepares the retained Triton test environment. `select_tests.py` follows source dependencies to select tests and benchmarks for the legacy job. Selection is an inventory operation; it is not a passing numerical or performance result.

Use the [script index](../../README.md) to find the exact caller and inputs. The [Triton implementation guide](../../../../aiter/ops/triton/README.md) describes the library code these jobs exercise.
